title: Eliminate Duplicates
required_features: Trusted generic polymorphic equality component injection, callable by synthesized code
semantic_obligations: The output is exactly the first element of each maximal non-empty contiguous equality run.
Output run representatives preserve source order.
Equal elements separated by a different value are not removed.
Empty input maps to empty output.
The boundary predicate is ordinary OCaml polymorphic structural equality, including its float and function-value behavior.

provenance.solution_quarantine: The upstream Solution section was stripped before statement inspection.

synthesis_evidence.runtime: pinned Synquid v0.4 under the required proot rootfs

attempt_1.result: The runtime tried to synthesize the declared external eq component and failed shape checking before a compress candidate was produced.

resolve_only.result: The exact datatype-valued runCompress relation resolves successfully.

attempt_2.result: Leaving eq as a hole also failed while synthesizing generic equality; no compress candidate was emitted.

notes: The full logical contract is expressible and resolves, but this runtime has no supported external/trusted-component declaration that makes OCaml polymorphic equality available to synthesis without requiring Synquid to synthesize generic equality itself. That component injection/import facility is the minimal missing feature. The target algorithm remains only compress = ??. No candidate was manually translated or semantically tested. test_generated.ml was compiled against an explicitly labelled deliberately-wrong negative-control stub only; its failure is evidence that the harness is active, not evidence about a candidate.
